text:
maria (PM): quick kick-off: proposal for a 'commit window + grace band' model for dedicated reservations. idea: give customers a predictable commit window but allow small burst forgiveness via grace credits so short spikes don't immediately hit fallback. want alignment on launch criteria, billing, and ops.

tony (Eng): high-level thumbs up. can you define "grace credits" precisely? minutes? requests?

maria (PM): thinking credits = minutes of equivalent peak capacity (token minutes). each reservation tier gets X credits per billing period; credits replenish monthly. credits consumed during spikes.

priya (Infra): infra note: implementing persistent idle GPUs for grace is expensive. prefer a hybrid: soft warm-pool + preemptible fast-path. we can maintain per-tenant token bookkeeping and pin tiny KV slices while credits active.

lee (SRE): ops: need strict rollback and canary plan. if grace use leads to increased error/latency, we should auto-suspend grace for that tenant and page. suggested triggers: p99 > 500ms for 5m OR error-rate +1% sustained 5m.

sam (Finance): billing question: include small baseline of credits in reservation or sell credits as add-on? two options: subscription-included credits or pay-as-you-burn. prefer hybrid: small included allotment + purchasable top-ups.

anya (Legal): customers will want clear definitions in SLA: what qualifies as "grace consumption", credit expiry, and remediation. also require consent for cross-region fallback if used as a fallback path.

rachel (ProductOps): pilot considerations: we should limit pilot to <=3 customers and require contract addendum. also surface tenant-visible credits API so customers can see balance.

tony (Eng): implementation sketch:
- CreditManager service: tracks token_minutes per-reservation, emits metrics.
- Routing: reserved -> grace_credit_lane -> fallback_variant.
- Soft KV pin while grace active; soft-evict LRU after grace or N minutes.

priya (Infra): technical detail: use soft-eviction + small warm pool per tenant when credits used to reduce thundering. need new metric tags: reservation_id.

lee (SRE): runbook bullets:
- Pre-launch chaos: exhaust credits and validate fallback flow (quantized model & region spill).
- Canary: 1% traffic internal canary for 48h.
- Escalation: if rollback triggers hit, suspend grace for tenant and route to fallback; page oncall.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria proposal:
- SLO: under committed baseline + grace consumption, p95 < 160ms, p99 < 320ms.
- Failover: when credits exhausted, added tail-latency < 500ms for 99% of requests.
- Observability: per-tenant credit_balance, credit_rate_used, failover_count, and daily digest.
- Billing: default includes small monthly credit allotment; top-ups available. pricing rec to Finance.
- Safety: automatic suspension of grace if rollback triggers hit.

tony (Eng): ops config sketch:
```
commit_window:
  commit_minutes: 43200 # month-equivalent
  grace_mode: token_minutes
  included_credits: 30
  max_topup: 120
  fallback_order: quantized_model, spill_region
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_ms: 500
    error_rate_pct: 1
```

priya (Infra): metrics & infra tasks: ingest per-tenant credit metrics, routing hook in smart-router, soft-evict support. filing INFRA ticket now.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-5288 "per-tenant commit-window credit metrics ingestion" assigned to eng-infra.

lee (SRE): monitoring to add: credit_balance < 20% for 30m -> notify account manager; credit_balance == 0 -> add failover alert and track failover_latency histogram.

sam (Finance): I'll model two price points: inclusive allotment (monthly uplift) vs PAYG credit top-up. will post spreadsheet tomorrow. pilot customers must sign addendum.

anya (Legal): drafting SLA language: define "credit consumption" window, expiry, and remediation. cross-region spill opt-in to be explicit.

rachel (ProductOps): customer UX asks: expose credit_balance in console, API endpoint, and in billing page. need DevEx docs.

maria (PM): rollout timeline suggested:
- Week 0: finalize design + pricing + SLA draft
- Week 1-3: engineering sprint (CreditManager + routing + metrics)
- Week 4: internal canary + chaos testing
- Week 5: pilot with up to 3 customers (contract addendum)
- Week 6: evaluate pilot; GA if metrics meet acceptance criteria
tony (Eng): dependency: metric ingestion + routing hook. raising PR for CreditManager proto. will link.

priya (Infra): will prototype soft-eviction and warm-pool behavior.

lee (SRE): preparing canary checklist and chaos scenarios. recommend forced exhaustion test for every fallback path.

maria (PM): next steps: tony + priya to deliver 1-pager spec by EOD Wed; sam posts pricing model; anya drafts SLA; rachel drafts console mock. scheduling 30m sync Thu morning.

tony (Eng): ack, will post spec in product-docs.

priya (Infra): ack. filing infra tickets after this thread.

lee (SRE): ack, will circulate checklist.

maria (PM): thanks all :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for commit-window + grace band launch decisions.
